glacier.pdf.title: Retreat of the Varn Glacier, 1990-2020
pages: The Varn Glacier is a valley glacier in a temperate maritime climate. Field campaigns ran every summer from 1990 to 2020 using GPS stakes and drone photogrammetry.
Between 1990 and 2020 the terminus of the Varn Glacier retreated by 1.8 kilometres. Retreat was fastest after 2005, averaging 85 metres per year.
The main driver was rising summer air temperature, about 1.1 degrees Celsius over the study period. Winter snowfall did not change significantly.
Limitations: drone surveys began only in 2012, so earlier volume changes are estimated from stake data and carry larger uncertainty.

bees.pdf.title: Urban Gardens and Wild Bee Diversity
pages: We surveyed wild bees in 42 urban gardens over two seasons using pan traps and timed netting walks.
Gardens with more than 20 flowering plant species hosted on average 31 bee species, compared with 14 species in gardens with fewer than 10 flowering species.
Lawn area was negatively associated with bee diversity. Pesticide use was reported by 6 of the 42 gardeners and was linked to lower abundance of ground-nesting bees.
We recommend replacing part of the lawn with native flowering plants that bloom from early spring to late autumn.
